sources.title: hersxy/era5-t2m-lstm · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: era5-t2m-lstm — LSTM 24 h forecast of ERA5 2 m temperature Predicts the next 24 hours of 2 m air temperature at any ERA5 grid cell in the region below, from the previous 72 hours at that cell. One shared model for every cell; location enters through normalised latitude/longitude inputs.

sources.title: LSTM and Transformer-based framework for bias correction of ERA5 hourly ...
sources.snippet: The model used meteorological variables (wind speed, wind direction, and gravity wave dissipation) from ERA5 and high-resolution topography data to predict observed wind speed. Houndekindo et al. [31] compared various ML methods for the BC of ERA5 wind speeds.

sources.title: AIFL: A global daily streamflow forecasting model using deterministic ...
sources.snippet: This paper introduces AIFL (Artificial Intelligence for Floods), a deterministic LSTM-based model designed for global daily streamflow forecasting. Trained on 18,588 basins curated from the Caravan dataset, AIFL utilises a two-stage transfer-learning strategy to bridge the reanalysis-to-forecast domain shift.

sources.title: WeatherBench: ERA5 Benchmark for Forecasting
sources.snippet: WeatherBench is an ERA5-derived benchmark dataset and evaluation framework that standardizes data-driven, medium-range global weather forecasting with common setups.
